meta.name: compose-creator-layer
meta.description: Composite a generated creator track into a product layer, per beat — in the creator's zone on split beats (either side of a seam), full frame on creator beats, hidden on product beats — with the creator's voice as the audio (loudness -14 LUFS) and an optional ducked music bed, or a music-only or silent master for voiceless formats. Free, local ffmpeg. Pairs with footage-cutlist (the layer) and create-creator-takes-h3 (the creator). Use for split-screen, screen-insert and any creator-over-product format.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把创作者画面按节拍合成进产品视频,自动做分屏与全屏,输出带配音或配乐的成片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要做创作者出镜或分屏形式的产品视频并想在本地直接合成
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you make creator-over-product videos and want to composite them locally

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把生成的创作者画面按节拍合成进产品视频层:分割节拍放在创作者区域,创作者节拍满屏,产品节拍隐藏;音频用创作者人声(-14 LUFS),可加压低音量的音乐垫,也可输出纯音乐或无声母版。
howto.when: 当你做分屏、画面插入等「创作者叠加在产品上」的格式时触发,由它把创作者轨道按节拍合进产品层。

say.text: 用 --audio music 出一个纯音乐母版,给无口播的付费广告
加 --head 0.30,让创作者缩放覆盖时头部留在上三分之一

howto.what_en: Per beat, Claude composites a creator track into the product layer: creator's zone on split beats, full frame on creator beats, hidden on product beats. Audio: creator voice (-14 LUFS), optional ducked music bed, or music-only/silent.
howto.when_en: Use when you need split-screen, screen-insert or any creator-over-product format, compositing a creator track into a product layer per beat.

say_en.text: Composite creator.mp4 into layer.mp4 per cutlist beats, output reel.mp4
Render a music-only master with --audio music for a voiceless paid ad
say_en.note: Output keeps the music bed alone

say_en.text: Add --head 0.30 so the head stays in the upper third when covering an area
